detailed_descriptions.en: Unleash your creativity and bring classic 16-bit gaming adventures to life with our intuitive, visual scripting game engine! Inspired by your favorite “Blast Processing”-powered system, this engine allows both beginners and experienced creators to build authentic, nostalgic games effortlessly. With its easy-to-use, drag-and-drop event system, you can design diverse game experiences without writing a single line of code. Create thrilling platformers, intense shooters, immersive action RPGs and even combine multiple genres in a single game! Let your imagination run wild as you craft engaging worlds, memorable characters, and compelling narratives, in all their 16-bit glory! Just like they did it back in the day, only a lot easier! Our integrated Debugger gives you complete control, allowing you to monitor palettes, global and local variables, actor positions, and game logic in real-time. Perfect your gameplay, optimize performance, and polish your mechanics with powerful debugging tools at your fingertips. Key Features: Visual Scripting: Quickly prototype and refine gameplay using intuitive drag-and-drop events. Retro Graphics: Craft visually authentic 16-bit games effortlessly. Versatile Gameplay Creation: Easily build platformers, shooters, action RPGs, puzzle games, and more. Powerful Debugging: Real-time insights into palettes, variables, actor coordinates, and event logic. Beginner-Friendly, Expert-Ready: Accessible to newcomers yet robust enough for seasoned game developers. Export and Play on Original Hardware: Easily export your games, burn them to cartridges, and enjoy your creations on original retro hardware. The games have been tested so far on Sega Mega Drive 1 (JP NTCS), 2 (PAL), and Genesis 1-3 (NTCS) original models, as well as with Retron3 HD and MegaSG consoles! Web Export: Export your game to HTML5 and upload it to the internet for everyone to see! Steam Integration: Export for Windows with full support for Steam, including Steam Achievements to enhance your game's reach and player engagement. Made with MD Engine Square Brothers : A cooperative platformer Inkventure: A colorful puzzle platformer Prisonela MD: An action platformer adventure All built with visual scripting. All running on real Mega Drive hardware. The Editor UI & Visual Scripting System is based on GB Studio by Chris Maltby

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Unleash your creativity and bring classic 16-bit gaming adventures to life with our intuitive, visual scripting game engine!

Inspired by your favorite “Blast Processing”-powered system, this engine allows both beginners and experienced creators to build authentic, nostalgic games effortlessly.

With its easy-to-use, drag-and-drop event system, you can design diverse game experiences without writing a single line of code. Create thrilling platformers, intense shooters, immersive action RPGs and even combine multiple genres in a single game! Let your imagination run wild as you craft engaging worlds, memorable characters, and compelling narratives, in all their 16-bit glory! Just like they did it back in the day, only a lot easier!

Our integrated Debugger gives you complete control, allowing you to monitor palettes, global and local variables, actor positions, and game logic in real-time. Perfect your gameplay, optimize performance, and polish your mechanics with powerful debugging tools at your fingertips.


Key Features:

  • Visual Scripting: Quickly prototype and refine gameplay using intuitive drag-and-drop events.

  • Retro Graphics: Craft visually authentic 16-bit games effortlessly.

  • Versatile Gameplay Creation: Easily build platformers, shooters, action RPGs, puzzle games, and more.

  • Powerful Debugging: Real-time insights into palettes, variables, actor coordinates, and event logic.

  • Beginner-Friendly, Expert-Ready: Accessible to newcomers yet robust enough for seasoned game developers.

  • Export and Play on Original Hardware: Easily export your games, burn them to cartridges, and enjoy your creations on original retro hardware. The games have been tested so far on Sega Mega Drive 1 (JP NTCS), 2 (PAL), and Genesis 1-3 (NTCS) original models, as well as with Retron3 HD and MegaSG consoles!

  • Web Export: Export your game to HTML5 and upload it to the internet for everyone to see!

  • Steam Integration: Export for Windows with full support for Steam, including Steam Achievements to enhance your game's reach and player engagement.

Made with MD Engine

Square Brothers: A cooperative platformer

Inkventure: A colorful puzzle platformer

 Prisonela MD: An action platformer adventure

 All built with visual scripting. All running on real Mega Drive hardware.

The Editor UI & Visual Scripting System is based on GB Studio by Chris Maltby
